name: (Ulgrem-Axaan) Ichor Coating

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

text: Beneath the plates of bone and ice on Ulgrem-Axaan flow the viscous remains of its vital fluids. Creatures coming into physical contact with this fluid must succeed at a DC 22 Fortitude save save or become infected with Ghoul Fever.
